messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "adults with high blood cholesterol due to heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)"
set: ["adults with high blood cholesterol due to heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)", "children 8 years of age and older with high blood cholesterol due to heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)", "children 7 years of age and older with high blood cholesterol due to homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HoFH)", "children with other types of hypercholesterolemia", "adults with obesity", "adults with atrial fibrillation", "adults with type 2 diabetes", "adults", "high blood sugar when medicine is stopped", "adults (moderate to severe primary RLS)", "older adults", "high doses", "adults and pediatric patients with type 1 diabetes", "adults with type 2 diabetes and known heart disease", "adults with chronic kidney disease and type 2 diabetes", "adults and children"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
